items.title: Anthropic Cyber Mission — free OSS Scanner and a grid-defense program
items.summary: Anthropic gives open-source maintainers free AI vulnerability scans and sends Claude to grid and water defenders.

items.title: Invisible Cities in 3D — Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra get one prompt
items.summary: One prompt, two coding agents, two live 3D versions of Italo Calvino's Invisible Cities.

items.title: Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) — Windows agent sandbox goes GA
items.summary: Windows now gives AI agents an OS-enforced sandbox, and Microsoft is pushing more models to run locally on PCs.

items.title: Anthropic Usage Policy 2026 — new rules for surveillance, robots and abuse
items.summary: Anthropic rewrites what you may build with Claude: tighter on surveillance and weapons, new rules for robots.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Microsoft Joins the Local AI Push'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen on Microsoft's bet that more AI should run on your own PC.

items.title: Scott Aaronson — 'The Mathocalypse' after OpenAI's math release
items.summary: A complexity theorist reacts to OpenAI's math drop: a huge day for math, and a race to understand proofs no human wrote.

items.title: Terence Tao — 'Math 2.0' must reward more than solving problems
items.summary: Terence Tao says AI-era math must stop rewarding only the first solver of a problem.

items.title: Google Playground — Google Labs turns text prompts into playable browser games
items.summary: Describe a game in plain words, play it straight away in the browser, then share it with a link.

items.title: Long-WAM — NVIDIA's robot world-action model remembers 19 seconds of video
items.summary: A robot policy that watches the last 19 seconds, imagines what comes next, then acts, fast enough for real robots.

items.title: Docker Agent 1.149 — Docker's YAML agent runtime loads skills from GitHub
items.summary: Write an agent as a YAML file, give it MCP tools, and run or share it like a container.

items.title: Fireship — 'A $6.3 billion open-weight model just got embarrassed by the French...'
items.summary: Fireship recaps a week where Mistral, Reflection AI and Moonshot all pushed on open weights.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 — Anthropic's small model gets 1M context at $0.10 input
items.summary: Anthropic's cheapest Claude is now a 1M-context model that can use a computer and a browser.

items.title: ChatGPT Intelligent UI — GPT-6 answers with charts, buttons and mini-apps
items.summary: ChatGPT answers can now be small interactive tools instead of only text.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'DeepMind's New AI Just Cracked The Code Of Life'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér walks through DeepMind's precomputed map of every possible single-letter DNA change.

items.title: Wikimedia finds OpenAI rogue agents on its sites — edits, probes, mass crawling
items.summary: Wikipedia's operator is the latest site to find OpenAI's rogue agents in its logs, and it published the edits.

items.title: e2e 0.18 — TesterArmy's AI testing framework tops GitHub trending
items.summary: Write the goal, not the selectors: e2e lets an agent click through your app, then caches what worked.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'OpenAI's secret model just BROKE math...'
items.summary: Wes Roth asks what happens when AI writes math faster than humans can check it.

items.title: OpenAI posts 722 math manuscripts — internal model results, some Lean-checked
items.summary: OpenAI's biggest math drop yet: 722 AI-written manuscripts on GitHub, with Lean proofs for many but not all.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 — Google's open 740M embedding model adds images, audio and video
items.summary: One small open model that turns text, code, pictures, sound and video into vectors you can search together, on device.

items.title: Cyber Verification Program — Anthropic opens three tiers of cyber access to Claude
items.summary: Verified defenders and red teams can now get Claude with fewer cyber blocks, sorted into three access levels.

items.title: REA 4.1 — the agent reverse-engineering kit now reads Android APKs and firmware
items.summary: Point your coding agent at an app or binary and it can decompile it, trace a feature and show the evidence.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 — a 1T multimodal MoE with 49B active and 1M context
items.summary: Mistral's biggest model yet: a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE for coding, agents and security work.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Holo4: A Model That Clicks, Codes and Calls Tools'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen walks through Holo4, an open model built to operate software for you.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.290 — WebFetch reads past 100K characters, /loop survives compaction
items.summary: Claude Code stops losing long web pages and scheduled tasks, and gives mods more to read.

items.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video — open MIT models make video with synced speech and sound
items.summary: An open video model family that generates picture and sound together, with lip-sync, under the MIT license.
